StimmFolgen tracker with live Apertus source matching and private notes
StimmFolgen lets people find and track selected Swiss votes, explore dated sources, updates, related votes and perspectives, and save optional encrypted private notes. The AHV explanation is released only after the bounded source/model/semantic Gate 0 guard passes.

Live hosted Apertus now interprets a neutral search query before deterministic retrieval and a separate check against the original question. This recovers the previously missed taxes/spending-cuts attribution without a runtime question-to-answer map. All factual text, types, actors and source spans remain the human-approved ledger; model prose cannot enter factual fields. Deployment responses are pinned to the authenticated evidence/prompt contract. Private choices and notes are never attached to public questions.

Validation:
- Actual hosted Apertus v1.5 8B: original real AHV suite 13/13; combined development sets 34/38 exact scope/reference matches. Four remaining failures publish no factual claims. Full raw traces, rejected unsafe prompt/fallback experiments and unsuccessful native experiments are retained.
- Agent-operated desktop 1280×800 and responsive phone 389×845: search → track → My votes → live attribution → sources/dates → updates/related/perspectives → encrypted synthetic note save/reload/unlock.
